body:
## What it does

A cost-control layer for anyone running a lot of automated work on X. Jobs that would otherwise burn through metered quota get pushed onto a local execution path instead, with lookups carried out on the machine and browser session the bot itself controls, so signing in happens there rather than via the API.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @cgnot996 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
